info.name: Tidings
info.summary: Fast JMAP mail with search by meaning
info.description:
A fast mail client for JMAP servers such as Stalwart.
- The browser talks to the mail server directly over JMAP, so the inbox opens without a server-side sync. - Sign-in uses the mail server's own OAuth; Nextcloud never sees the mail password. - Recipients come from your Nextcloud Contacts, and senders can be saved there. - Attach files from your Nextcloud, or send large files as share links. - Optional search by meaning, powered by a separate indexing service.
info.author: Daniel
